ios.desc:
Turn your videos into living home screen widgets with cool retro effects. Real live video!

Widget Cast captures, filters, and casts short clips onto your iPhone and Apple Watch - so the moments you care about are right there on your device.

-- EFFECTS --
• CRT
• Night vision
• Pixellate
• Colour tint
• Thermal camera
+ many more!

-- WIDGETS --
• Home screen widgets in multiple sizes
• Pick your favourites to show where you like

-- PLAYLISTS --
• Collect your favourite videos into playlists and play them back in the widget
• Control how often they loop, shuffle and transition effects

-- WATCH --
• Watch on your watch too!

-- PRO --
• One simple unlock for all extra features, no subscriptions

-- PRIVACY --
• Everything stays on your phone or watch

show_hn.title: Show HN: Widget Cast – Video Widgets for Your iPhone and Apple Watch

quotes.text:
Hello! I've just released Widget Cast today, it's a little app to make looping animated widgets for iOS. Take any video and and you can trim to 10 seconds or less, then apply a load of effects like CRT, night vision, thermal, colour tint, etc - then see it animate away on your home screen.

App store: https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/widget-cast-video-widgets/id6767938501

Got a glowing futuristic website here too: https://widgetcastapp.com

If you have an Apple watch, you can view them there too.

Could be a special moment or person, or just a dinosaur jumping up & down (which is also special).

It's free with some effects behind IAP (there are sort-of pay-what-you-want tiers). No subscriptions or ads.

Hopefully it's good fun!
